battle.name: 王須拔
battle.brief: 大業十一年（615年），上谷人王須拔聚眾十萬起事，自稱漫天王、國號燕，轉戰河北山西，攻克河間高陽後進逼幽州涿郡，中流矢而亡，部眾歸魏刀兒。起義軍攻城以拋石車、撞木破垣，隋軍憑城堞、弩陣與火攻拒守；卡面這件羅馬扭力式投石機早於本役八百餘年，與東亞砲車同類而形制不同。

kit.name: 投石機
kit.history: 把絞盤的勢能換成一塊石頭。攻城從此有了可以計算的破壞力。

countries: 大業十一年（615年）的河北，從年初到年尾都被一場接一場的起義燒得發紅。叛亂一方是上谷人王須拔聚起來的十萬眾，號稱漫天王、國號燕，部眾多為河北、山西兩地的失業農民、逃戶、流民與散兵，馬步雜糅，器械簡陋，靠流動劫掠維繫給養，攻下城池即取官倉之糧。北面同年八月有突厥始畢可汗率十餘萬騎深入，攻圍雁門，隋煬帝與百官、宮人被困雁門城，先後四十餘日不得解圍，朝廷詔天下募兵救援，北方各州郡的兵丁被抽調一空，給叛軍留下大片空白。與王須拔同時起兵的河北人魏刀兒，自稱歷山飛，據深澤，後稱魏帝；兩人互相援引又互相爭地，最後王須拔戰死，眾部歸魏刀兒收編，合成一股十萬之眾。朝廷一方以幽州（涿郡）為北方軍鎮，郡兵、城防民兵與河北各州縣的團練分頭抵禦，郡治高陽一失，州縣望風瓦解。第三方則是北面牽制朝廷的突厥，以及在東北與隋廷爭地的高句麗；隋軍在河北既缺兵又缺糧，只能死守幾座堅城，秩序自西北向中原一路鬆動。
countriesEn: Throughout the year 615 the Hebei plain burned with one rising after another. The insurgents were the hundred thousand men mustered by Wang Xuba, a native of Shanggu, who styled himself the King Who Fills the Sky and gave his force the state-name of Yan; they were for the most part out-of-work farmers, runaways, displaced households and stray soldiers from the Hebei and Shanxi countryside, horse and foot mixed together, thinly equipped, and kept alive by moving plunder, for whenever they took a walled town they at once carried off the grain from its official granaries. In the north, in the eighth month of the same year, the Turkic khagan Shibi led more than a hundred thousand cavalry deep into the frontier and walled in Yanmen; Emperor Yang with his officials and his palace women was shut up in the city for more than forty days, and the court called on the whole empire for troops, which stripped the garrisons of the northern commanderies bare and left wide gaps for the insurgents. Rising in the same month as Wang Xuba, the Hebei man Wei Dao'er called himself Li Shan Fei, based himself at Shenze and later took the title of Emperor of Wei; the two men supported and quarrelled with each other in turn, and when Wang Xuba was killed in the field his followers were taken over by Wei Dao'er, the two crowds of a hundred thousand merging into one. On the court's side the hinge was Youzhou, that is Zhu Jun, the great northern garrison of the Sui, held by commandery soldiers, city militia and the levies of the Hebei prefectures and counties; once Gaoyang, the seat of its commandery, fell, the smaller towns came down in panic. The third parties were the Turks on the north, pinning the court in place, and Goguryeo in the northeast, still holding its ground after a decade of Sui campaigns; the Sui army in Hebei, short of men and short of grain alike, could only sit tight inside a few strong cities, and the whole order of the north-west began to loosen towards the plains.
people: 王須拔是上谷（今河北易縣）人，隋末燕地起義中最見鋒芒的名字之一。大業十一年，他聚眾十萬，自稱漫天王、國號燕，轉戰於河北與山西之間，先取高陽，再逼幽州。史載他是在攻幽州的戰陣上中箭而死，一支起義隊伍的核心就此瓦解，剩下的部眾由同鄉魏刀兒接手。魏刀兒也是河北人，同年聚眾十萬，自稱歷山飛，後據深澤稱魏帝，吞併王須拔之眾後成為河北叛軍的主幹，直到大業十四年（618年）才被竇建德暗算俘殺，部眾併入夏軍。朝廷這邊，隋煬帝楊廣大業十一年正在涿郡一帶，因八月雁門被圍而四面求援，河北各郡的兵力多被抽調；河南方向的猛將張須陀則在河北、河南一線追擊各路叛軍，屢次得手，是隋廷倚重的幹才之一。北面是突厥始畢可汗，趁隋廷困於雁門而南下掠地；東北的高句麗在隋軍連年征討之後仍據城拒守，讓隋朝把更多的錢糧與人力填進遼東戰線。而隋煬帝下達的募兵詔令，既是救命的辦法，也把河北鄉里最後一批可用之兵抽進了這場戰爭。
peopleEn: Wang Xuba was a man of Shanggu, in what is now Yixian in Hebei, and among the risings of the Yan lands in the last years of the Sui he was the sharpest name of them all. In the eleventh year of Daye he mustered a hundred thousand men, styled himself the King Who Fills the Sky, gave his force the state-name of Yan, and rode up and down the country between Hebei and Shanxi, taking Gaoyang first and then pressing on towards Youzhou. The histories record that he was struck by an arrow and killed in the ranks while he was assaulting Youzhou; the core of that rising broke up on the spot, and what was left of his men passed to a fellow villager, Wei Dao'er. Wei Dao'er was also a Hebei man; in the same year he mustered a hundred thousand of his own, called himself Li Shan Fei, and later, from Shenze, took the title of Emperor of Wei. After he swallowed up Wang Xuba's followers he became the main body of the Hebei insurgents, and he was not destroyed until the fourteenth year of Daye (618), when Dou Jiande had him taken by surprise and executed, his troops being absorbed into the Xia army. On the court's side, Emperor Yang of Sui, Yang Guang, was in the neighbourhood of Zhu Jun in the eleventh year of Daye; with Yanmen under siege in the eighth month he called for help on every side, and the garrisons of the Hebei commanderies were largely drawn away to answer that call. In the south, the fierce general Zhang Xutuo was hunting the various rebel bands along the Hebei and Henan lines and scoring success after success, and he was one of the props on which the Sui leaned. On the north the Turkic khagan Shibi came down to graze and plunder while the court was pinned at Yanmen; in the north-east Goguryeo, after years of Sui invasion, still held its cities and refused to come out, keeping more of the dynasty's money, grain and manpower flowing into the Liaodong front. The recruiting edict Emperor Yang issued was at once the answer to the emergency and the means by which the last usable soldiers of the Hebei countryside were drawn into this war.
kits: 卡面上這件投石機，即今日以 onager 相稱的扭力式石投射機，是前三世紀在義大利半島發展出來的重型攻城器械：機身靠扭緊的繩束儲能，發射時把石塊、甚至裝了燃油的陶罐拋向城牆與城頭，用途一是砸塌牆體與女牆，二是壓制守軍頭頂，封住城門通道。它是西地中海世界的產物，與本役相隔八百餘年，不可能出現在河北的城牆之下；真正與它同類同職的，是東亞自漢末以來一直在用的拋石車，也就是隋唐兵書與軍令中說的砲車：以槓桿配重或弩機絞索發射石彈與陶罐，攻城時用來破垣、擊傷城頭守卒，並掩護雲梯登城。大業十一年的攻城配置大致可以這樣推想：叛軍用砲車作遠程覆蓋，企圖打掉高陽城頭的射孔與垛口，用撞木反覆撞擊城門，並備雲梯與穴地同時上；守城的隋軍則依靠城牆、女牆與角樓的分層射擊，弓弩分批封住登城點，再以火攻與拒馬堵住缺口。步卒裝備以長矛、戈、盾、弓箭為主，披甲比例低；騎兵數量有限，攻城器械與糧秣的運輸靠步卒和徵用來的牲畜完成。攻城之後，叛軍還能就地取用官倉的糧食、冶坊的鐵器與武庫的甲兵，這正是他們越打越壯的來源。
kitsEn: The engine on the card is the stone-thrower now called an onager, a heavy siege machine developed in the Italian peninsula of the third century BC: its power is stored in tightly twisted ropes, and on release it lobs stones, and even earthenware jars filled with burning oil, at walls and battlements, its uses being to break down masonry and parapets and to blanket the defenders overhead so as to seal the approaches to the gate. It is a product of the western Mediterranean world and stands more than eight hundred years away from this campaign, so it cannot have stood beneath the walls of Hebei; the machines that actually correspond to it in function are the stone-throwers of East Asia, in use since the end of the Han, the pao-che that appear in Sui and Tang military manuals and orders: shooting stones and jars by counterweighted lever or by the winch of a heavy crossbow, used to breach walls, to strike the soldiers on the rampart, and to cover the bringing up of scaling ladders. The equipment of a siege in 615 can be reconstructed along these lines. The insurgents used stone-throwers for long-range coverage, trying to knock down the firing slits and crenellations of the towers at Gaoyang; they hammered the gates with battering beams; and they prepared ladders and mining to be used at the same time. The Sui defenders answered with layered shooting from the wall, the parapet and the corner towers, bows and crossbows sealing the points where ladders might be set, and with fire and chevaux-de-frise to plug any breach. The foot soldiers carried spear, ge, shield and bow, with little armour; cavalry was scarce, and the moving of siege engines and provisions fell to the infantry and to requisitioned draught animals. After a city fell, the insurgents could also take from it the grain of the official granaries, the iron of the foundries and the arms of the armoury, and that was the source of their growth.
tactics: 王須拔的十萬眾走的不是正規軍的路子。他們在燕地鄉里聚兵，先以流動劫掠取得糧食、鐵器與布帛，避開隋軍主力所在的大城，專打郡縣治所與驛站，沿太行山東麓南北縱橫轉戰，形成到處響應、到處又迅速轉移的局面；一支隊伍打空就換地方重新集結。攻城時的作法是多器並用：砲車在後排遠程覆蓋城頭，撞木抵近城門猛撞，雲梯在側翼同時靠牆，穴地隊伍在牆根下掘進，逼迫守軍分兵應付四個方向；每有得手，便打開缺口驅趕守卒，並就地取官倉的糧食與甲兵。攻下高陽之後，他沒有分兵去掃平鄉里，而是把十萬眾集中北進，試圖趁隋廷兵馬被北援與西征抽空的空檔直取幽州。幽州城垣堅固、糧械齊備，援軍又陸續抵達，攻城曠日持久，叛軍久攻不下的疲勞在城郊累積；王須拔本人在指揮攻勢時中箭身亡，群龍無首之下部眾退回鄉里，隨即被魏刀兒整編。隋廷這邊的應對則是先守城、後剿殺：郡兵固守要點，不在野外與十萬眾糾纏，再由張須陀等率精兵搜討、追擊小股散兵，試圖把流民重新壓回郡縣之外的荒野，讓官軍的巡騎重新控制驛道與津渡。
tacticsEn: The hundred thousand men of Wang Xuba did not fight the way a regular army fights. They mustered in the villages of the Yan country, first taking grain, iron and cloth by moving plunder, keeping away from the great cities where the Sui army lay concentrated, and striking instead at the seats of commanderies and counties and at the courier stations, running up and down the eastern foot of the Taihang range. The result was an insurrection that answered everywhere and shifted quickly everywhere, a band that was spent one place being re-raised in the next. At a city wall they worked several instruments at once: stone-throwers in the rear covering the battlements, battering beams set against the gate, ladders brought up on the flank, and miners digging at the foot of the wall, so that the defenders had to divide to meet four threats at once. At every opening they forced they drove the defenders out and took the grain and the arms of the official granary on the spot. After Gaoyang fell he did not scatter his men to sweep the countryside; he concentrated the hundred thousand and marched north, hoping that while the Sui army was pinned by the relief of Yanmen and by the campaigns in the north-east he could take Youzhou outright. Youzhou had strong walls, full stores and a stream of reinforcements; the siege dragged on, and the exhaustion of an assault that had not succeeded accumulated in the fields outside the city. Wang Xuba was struck by an arrow while directing the attack, and without a head to follow, his men fell back into the country and were immediately re-formed by Wei Dao'er. The court's answer was to defend first and to hunt afterwards: the commandery soldiers held the strong points and did not trade blows with the hundred thousand in the open country, while men such as Zhang Xutuo led picked columns out to search for and chase the small scattered bands, trying to push the displaced people back into the wilds beyond the prefectures and to put the Sui patrols back in control of the post roads and the crossings.
data: 可以核對的數字不多，但有幾個是明確的。起義本身的規模是聚眾十萬，《資治通鑑》與後世史籍都記王須拔大業十一年聚眾十萬，自稱漫天王、國號燕；同年在河北起兵的魏刀兒也是十萬眾，兩支大軍在同一片土地上並存，說明隋末河北的失控已不是個別豪強的騷擾。同樣記錄在案的，是隋廷當年被抽空的樣子：大業十一年八月，突厥始畢可汗率十餘萬騎深入塞下，攻圍雁門，隋煬帝與隨行百官、宮人被困雁門城，先後四十一日不得解圍，直至朝廷分道遣使向天下募兵、各路兵馬與糧草陸續集到雁門城下，突厥才退兵北去。從高陽到涿郡的直線距離約二百里，王須拔自打下高陽到兵臨幽州，留給他的時間不過數月，正是利用北方主力被北援與西征抽空的那個空檔。叛軍器械的數量、攻城時的損失以及參戰各部的番號與編制，傳世記載都沒有留下可核的數目；這一場戰爭的具體起訖日與交戰序列，同樣無從核實，因此只能從州縣的存廢與兩名首領的下落去推斷它的規模。
dataEn: Few figures can be checked, but a few are clear. The scale of the rising itself is the hundred thousand men mustered: the Zizhi Tongjian and the later histories all record that in the eleventh year of Daye Wang Xuba gathered a hundred thousand, called himself the King Who Fills the Sky and took the state-name of Yan; Wei Dao'er, who rose in the same year in Hebei, also had a hundred thousand, and the two great crowds existing at once in the same country show that the collapse in late Sui Hebei was no longer the disorder of a single local magnate. Equally on record is the shape of the court that year: in the eighth month of the eleventh year of Daye the Turkic khagan Shibi led more than a hundred thousand cavalry deep over the frontier and walled in Yanmen, where Emperor Yang and the officials and palace women with him were shut up for forty-one days without relief, until the court sent envoys by every road to call up men for the war and the troops and provisions from the various circuits assembled under Yanmen, whereupon the Turks withdrew north. The direct distance from Gaoyang to Zhu Jun is about two hundred li; only a few months separated Wang Xuba's taking of Gaoyang from his appearance before Youzhou, and it was exactly the gap left by the northern army being drawn off for the relief of Yanmen and for the campaigns in the north-east that he meant to use. The numbers of the rebel engines, the losses of the siege and the designations of the units that took part have left no verifiable figures in the transmitted records; the exact opening and closing days of the fighting and the order of the engagements cannot be checked either, so the scale of the war has to be inferred from the fall of the prefectures and the fate of the two leaders.
cause: 起義的直接背景，是隋朝在東北與北面同時拉開的兩條戰線所留下的空隙。大業年間的連年征高句麗把天下的丁役、錢帛與糧食大批抽往遼東與山東、江南的運轉線上，河北各郡的民戶久已疲於徵發；大業十一年八月，突厥忽然深入至雁門，隋煬帝倉皇募兵，詔令天下的兵丁與輜重一齊向雁門集中，北方各城守兵隨之空虛，州縣的武備與倉儲只剩守門的一點人手。官府對民間的索取並未因此稍減，州縣的倉廩、冶所、馬政與差役照舊催斂，於是河北山東一帶的失業戶、逃戶與散兵被逼到無路可走的地步，聚集在山澤與鄉里之間，等一個敢先動手的人。王須拔正是這樣的人：他在上谷起事，旬日之間聚起十萬眾，先打掉太行山東麓的郡縣治所，把官府的倉儲與甲兵變成自己壯大的本錢。對朝廷而言，這已不是可以靠一紙詔書安撫的邊患，而是主力軍隊被遠方戰事釘在原地時，腹地自行崩解的開始。
causeEn: The immediate background of the rising was the gap left by two fronts that the Sui had opened at once, in the north-east and in the north. The campaigns against Goguryeo through the years of Daye drew off the levies, the money and the grain of the empire to the Liaodong front and to the supply lines of Shandong and Jiangnan, and the households of the Hebei commanderies had long been worn down by the levies exacted from them. In the eighth month of the eleventh year of Daye the Turks struck suddenly as far as Yanmen; Emperor Yang, in a panic, called for men, and the soldiers and baggage of the whole empire were ordered to move on Yanmen, so that the garrisons of the northern cities were emptied and the armaments and stores of the prefectures and counties were left with barely enough men to hold the gates. The court's demands on the countryside did not slacken in the least: the granaries, the foundries, the remount service and the corvée of the commanderies went on being dunned for, until in the Hebei and Shandong country the out-of-work, the runaways and the stray soldiers were driven to the point of no return and gathered in the hills and the villages, waiting for someone bold enough to move first. Wang Xuba was that man. He rose in Shanggu, gathered a hundred thousand men within a matter of days, and struck first at the seats of the commanderies and counties along the eastern foot of the Taihang, turning the stores and the arms of the government into the capital of his own growth. To the court this was no longer a frontier trouble to be settled by a single edict, but the beginning of the belly of the state coming apart by itself while the main army was nailed down far away.
impact: 大業十一年的河北，經王須拔與魏刀兒先後折騰，官軍在平原上的控制只剩下幾座可以死守的城。郡縣的牆垣、驛亭、烽堠多數落入叛軍之手，州官與縣令各自退守，政令出不了城門；同一時間，太原方向的劉武周、鄴下的張金稱相繼起事，河北與山西的起義連成一片，隋朝在北方的兵源與賦稅從此斷了根。城防一旦退守，攻守形勢也隨之改變，攻城器械的消耗與民間的私造同時加劇，拋石車、撞車、雲梯這些東西在隋末的各種割據軍隊手中被反覆改造，隋唐工官所造的攻城機械、以及唐太宗貞觀年間東征高句麗時所用的拋石車，其技術底子正是在這幾年裡被亂世重新拼起來的。對王須拔本人而言，這場戰爭只有兩個結局：兵臨幽州而攻不下，中箭身亡，勢力隨部眾一併被魏刀兒吞掉；他能留下的，只有燕這個國號，以及河北人記住了他起義先後的次序。
impactEn: After Wang Xuba and Wei Dao'er in turn had worked over Hebei in the eleventh year of Daye, the government's control of the plain came down to a few cities that could be held by the skin of the teeth. The walls of the prefectures and counties, the post stations and the beacon towers passed for the most part into the hands of the insurgents; the prefects and the district magistrates each retired behind their own gates, and government orders no longer got beyond the city walls. At the same time Liu Wuzhou in the direction of Taiyuan and Zhang Jincheng below Ye both rose in arms, so that the risings of Hebei and Shanxi ran together into one, and the Sui lost at a stroke the base of its man-power and its revenue in the north. Once the defence fell back inside the walls, the balance of attack and defence changed with it: siege engines were consumed faster and privately built in greater numbers, and the stone-throwers, battering beams and scaling ladders were rebuilt again and again by the various armed groups of the late Sui. The technical base of the siege machines made by the Sui and Tang imperial workshops, and of the stone-throwers used by Emperor Taizong's army against Goguryeo in the Zhenguan years, was assembled once again out of the experience of those few desperate years. For Wang Xuba himself the war had only two possible endings: he came up to Youzhou and could not take it, he was killed by an arrow, and his power was swallowed with his men by Wei Dao'er. What he left behind was the name Yan, and the fact that people in Hebei remembered the order in which his rising had been raised.
result: 就大業十一年這一年而言，局面是這樣收場的：王須拔聚眾十萬、自號漫天王、國號燕，攻克河間高陽，掠得官倉與甲兵，兵力直逼幽州涿郡，攻城不克而在陣中中箭身亡，所部由魏刀兒收編，河北的叛軍由兩股合成一股，由深澤向冀州、定州一線轉戰，直到大業十四年被竇建德暗算俘殺，部眾併入夏。朝廷這邊保住了幽州與北方幾座重鎮，卻再無力把河北、山西的州縣收回，兩年之後劉武周攻陷太原，隋朝在北方的統治實際上已經終結。大業十一年因此成了隋末的一個分水嶺：它證明了一次遠方戰事加一次草原入侵，就能把腹地的秩序抽空，也證明了城牆與守軍仍然可靠——河北的城守住了，但河北的鄉里沒有守住，這才是這場戰爭留下的真正結果。
resultEn: For the year 615 itself the business ended like this. Wang Xuba mustered a hundred thousand men, called himself the King Who Fills the Sky and gave his force the state-name of Yan; he took Gaoyang in the commandery of Hejian, carried off the grain of the official granary and the arms of the armoury, drove his army up to Youzhou and Zhu Jun, failed to take the city and was killed by an arrow in the ranks; his men were taken over by Wei Dao'er, and the two rebel crowds of Hebei merged into one, moving from Shenze towards Jizhou and Dingzhou until the fourteenth year of Daye, when Dou Jiande had Wei Dao'er taken by surprise and executed and his troops were absorbed into the Xia. The court kept Youzhou and a few of the northern strongpoints, but never recovered the prefectures and counties of Hebei and Shanxi, and two years later, when Liu Wuzhou took Taiyuan, Sui rule in the north was over in everything but name. The eleventh year of Daye therefore became a watershed of the late Sui: it showed that one distant campaign and one steppe invasion together could drain the order out of the heartland, and at the same time that walls and garrisons could still be trusted. The cities of Hebei held; the villages of Hebei did not. That, in the end, is the real result of this war.
